# appgatesdp_device_scripts_download (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `file` (String) The Device Claim Script binary in Base64 format.
- `filename` (String) The name of the file to be downloaded as to the client devices.
- `name` (String) Name of the Device Claim Script object.
